evals.prompt: Reproduce this pull_request failure for job lint-and-test with act and patch only what breaks in that job.
evals.expected_behavior: Lints the target workflow with action-validator first, runs a narrow act command targeting the exact event and job, captures the first failing step and error output before editing, applies a minimal fix, and re-runs the same local command until it passes.
assertions: Runs action-validator against the target workflow file before local execution
Uses a narrow act command such as `act pull_request -j lint-and-test` rather than running every job or event
Captures the first failing step and error output before making any edit
Keeps the fix scoped to the reproduced failing path
Avoids printing real secret values, using placeholder secret files or masked env values instead

evals.prompt: The build job started failing after a workflow edit; run it locally with act, isolate the failing step, and fix minimally.
evals.expected_behavior: Maps the hosted failure to the minimal act inputs needed (event, workflow file, job, and only the matrix axis or env values required), rather than running the full workflow across all jobs and matrix legs.
assertions: Targets only the specific failing job and event rather than running the whole workflow
Adds only the flags or env/matrix values required to reproduce the specific failing leg
Does not broaden the fix scope beyond the reproduced failing path

evals.prompt: The build job started failing after a workflow edit; run it locally with act, isolate the failing step, and fix minimally.
evals.expected_behavior: Reproduces the same failing step locally, applies the smallest fix, and re-runs the identical local command to confirm the previously failing step now passes, while noting any known gap between local and hosted behavior.
assertions: Compares the local failure to the hosted failing step to confirm the same step is being exercised
Re-runs the same local act command after the patch and confirms the previously failing step now passes
Calls out when local success may not guarantee hosted success (e.g. hosted-only services or policies)
deterministic_checks: the same `act` command used to reproduce the failure is re-run after the fix and reported as passing

evals.prompt: The job only fails on org-managed runners with protected environment secrets; logs show AccessDenied to the environment gate.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not force a futile act loop against a failure that depends on hosted-only or org-policy behavior; routes to github-actions-failure-triage or clearly notes the hosted-only/policy constraint and stops.
assertions: Recognizes the failure depends on org-managed runner or protected-environment behavior that act cannot represent
Does not insist a local act run can fully reproduce a protected-environment or org-policy failure
Routes to github-actions-failure-triage or clearly hands off with the specific mismatch documented instead of continuing to iterate locally

evals.prompt: I already have the exact failing log line and the root cause is confirmed -- just apply the direct fix, no need to reproduce it again with act.
evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes the user already has definitive failing evidence and asked for a direct fix without a local repro loop, so it applies the fix directly instead of insisting on running act first.
assertions: Does not force an act-based reproduction loop when the user already supplied definitive failing evidence and asked to skip it
Applies the requested direct fix rather than re-deriving root cause through local reproduction
